parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_agent_runs (
    run_key, workflow_name, workflow_version, scheduled_for,
    schedule_timezone, started_at, status, scope
  )
  select
    p->>'runKey', 'LND-WATCHER 2.0 - Prematch',
    p->>'workflowVersion', (p->>'scheduledFor')::timestamptz,
    p->>'timezone', now(), 'RUNNING',
    jsonb_build_object('mode', 'PREMATCH_REPORT')
  from payload
  on conflict (run_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select r.*
from public.lnd_agent_runs r, payload
where r.run_key = payload.p->>'runKey'
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

with villanovese as (
  select id from public.lnd_teams
  where team_key = 'it-veneto:asd-villanovese'
),
next_fixture as (
  select f.*
  from public.lnd_fixtures f
  cross join villanovese v
  where v.id in (f.home_team_id, f.away_team_id)
    and f.status in ('SCHEDULED', 'RESCHEDULED')
    and f.scheduled_date >= (now() at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date
  order by f.scheduled_date, f.kickoff_time nulls last, f.id
  limit 1
),
relevant_teams as (
  select nf.home_team_id as team_id, 'HOME'::text as venue
  from next_fixture nf
  union all
  select nf.away_team_id, 'AWAY'::text
  from next_fixture nf
),
measure_summary as (
  select
    dm.team_id,
    dm.person_id,
    count(*) filter (where dm.measure_type = 'DIFFIDA')::integer as diffide,
    count(*) filter (
      where dm.measure_type in ('SUSPENSION', 'EXPULSION')
    )::integer as suspension_measures,
    coalesce(sum(dm.gamedays) filter (
      where dm.measure_type in ('SUSPENSION', 'EXPULSION')
    ), 0)::integer as imposed_gamedays,
    max(d.published_at) as latest_source_at
  from public.lnd_disciplinary_measures dm
  join public.lnd_documents d on d.id = dm.document_id
  join next_fixture nf
    on nf.season_id = dm.season_id
   and nf.competition_id = dm.competition_id
  where dm.record_status = 'ACTIVE'
    and dm.verification_status = 'VERIFIED'
  group by dm.team_id, dm.person_id
),
ledger_balance as (
  select
    sl.team_id,
    sl.person_id,
    sum(sl.delta_gamedays)::integer as residual_gamedays
  from public.lnd_suspension_ledger sl
  join public.lnd_disciplinary_measures dm on dm.id = sl.measure_id
  join next_fixture nf
    on nf.season_id = sl.season_id
   and nf.competition_id = sl.competition_id
  where sl.verification_status = 'VERIFIED'
    and dm.record_status = 'ACTIVE'
  group by sl.team_id, sl.person_id
)
select
  nf.id as fixture_id,
  nf.scheduled_date,
  nf.kickoff_time,
  nf.kickoff_timezone,
  nf.status as fixture_status,
  nf.verification_status as fixture_verification_status,
  c.official_name as competition_name,
  c.kind as competition_kind,
  home.official_name as home_team_name,
  away.official_name as away_team_name,
  rt.venue,
  t.id as team_id,
  t.official_name as team_name,
  t.verification_status as team_verification_status,
  p.id as person_id,
  p.display_name,
  p.verification_status as person_verification_status,
  coalesce(ms.diffide, 0) as diffide,
  coalesce(ms.suspension_measures, 0) as suspension_measures,
  coalesce(ms.imposed_gamedays, 0) as imposed_gamedays,
  lb.residual_gamedays,
  ms.latest_source_at,
  case
    when nf.verification_status <> 'VERIFIED' then 'NON_VERIFICABILE'
    when p.id is null then 'NON_VERIFICABILE'
    when p.verification_status <> 'VERIFIED' then 'NON_VERIFICABILE'
    when lb.residual_gamedays is not null and lb.residual_gamedays < 0
      then 'NON_VERIFICABILE'
    else 'OK'
  end as report_data_status
from next_fixture nf
join public.lnd_competitions c on c.id = nf.competition_id
join public.lnd_teams home on home.id = nf.home_team_id
join public.lnd_teams away on away.id = nf.away_team_id
join relevant_teams rt on true
join public.lnd_teams t on t.id = rt.team_id
left join public.lnd_registrations r
  on r.team_id = t.id
 and r.season_id = nf.season_id
 and r.status = 'ACTIVE'
 and (r.valid_from is null or r.valid_from <= nf.scheduled_date)
 and (r.valid_to is null or r.valid_to >= nf.scheduled_date)
left join public.lnd_persons p on p.id = r.person_id
left join measure_summary ms
  on ms.team_id = t.id and ms.person_id = p.id
left join ledger_balance lb
  on lb.team_id = t.id and lb.person_id = p.id
order by rt.venue, p.display_name nulls last;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_prematch_reports (
    idempotency_key, fixture_id, source_run_id, generated_at,
    data_cutoff_at, content_markdown, content_sha256,
    verification_status, status
  )
  select
    concat(
      'prematch:', p->>'fixtureId', ':', p->>'localDate', ':',
      left(lower(p->>'contentSha256'), 16)
    ),
    (p->>'fixtureId')::uuid,
    (p->>'runId')::uuid,
    now(),
    now(),
    p->>'contentMarkdown',
    lower(p->>'contentSha256'),
    p->>'verificationStatus',
    'READY'
  from payload
  on conflict (idempotency_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select r.*
from public.lnd_prematch_reports r, payload
where r.idempotency_key = concat(
  'prematch:', payload.p->>'fixtureId', ':', payload.p->>'localDate', ':',
  left(lower(payload.p->>'contentSha256'), 16)
)
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_notifications (
    dedupe_key, run_id, measure_id, report_id, channel,
    destination_ref_hash, payload_sha256, payload_preview, status
  )
  select
    concat('telegram:report:', p->>'reportId', ':', left(p->>'destinationRefHash', 16)),
    (p->>'runId')::uuid,
    null,
    (p->>'reportId')::uuid,
    'TELEGRAM',
    p->>'destinationRefHash',
    lower(p->>'payloadSha256'),
    left(p->>'telegramMessage', 1000),
    case when coalesce((p->>'telegramEnabled')::boolean, false)
      then 'PENDING' else 'SKIPPED' end
  from payload
  on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select n.*
from public.lnd_notifications n, payload
where n.dedupe_key = concat(
  'telegram:report:', payload.p->>'reportId', ':',
  left(payload.p->>'destinationRefHash', 16)
)
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
notification_update as (
  update public.lnd_notifications n
  set
    status = case when nullif(p->>'error', '') is null then 'SENT' else 'FAILED' end,
    attempt_count = n.attempt_count + 1,
    provider_message_id = nullif(p->>'providerMessageId', ''),
    sent_at = case when nullif(p->>'error', '') is null then now() else n.sent_at end,
    last_error = nullif(left(p->>'error', 1000), '')
  from payload
  where n.id = (p->>'notificationId')::uuid
  returning n.*
)
update public.lnd_prematch_reports r
set status = case
  when exists (select 1 from notification_update n where n.status = 'SENT') then 'SENT'
  else 'FAILED'
end
from payload
where r.id = (p->>'reportId')::uuid
returning r.*;

parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p)
update public.lnd_agent_runs r
set
  finished_at = now(),
  status = case
    when exists (
      select 1 from public.lnd_notifications n
      where n.run_id = r.id and n.status = 'FAILED'
    ) then 'PARTIAL'
    else 'SUCCEEDED'
  end
from payload
where r.id = (p->>'runId')::uuid
returning r.*;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p)
update public.lnd_agent_runs r
set
  finished_at = now(),
  status = 'SKIPPED',
  error_code = 'NO_UPCOMING_FIXTURE',
  error_summary = 'Nessuna prossima fixture disponibile per il report.'
from payload
where r.id = (p->>'runId')::uuid
returning r.*;
